title: Toxic waste in Abidjan
body: A ship belonging to a multinational company dealing in petroleum and metals needed to get rid of liquid toxic waste. The company contracted a local company in the Ivory Coast, a country in Africa, to dispose of it. About 500 tonnes of the waste were dumped into open-air dumps in the city of Abidjan and into the surrounding sea. Fumes from the highly toxic waste caused nausea, skin rashes, fainting and diarrhoea among residents. After a month, seven persons were dead, twenty were in hospital and twenty-six thousand had been treated for symptoms of poisoning.
